analysis:
Integration over both prior analyses plus replayed source (5 of 210 units shown; 204 omitted). Replayed evidence: changelog.d/cluster-auto-update.md, docs/architecture/inference.md, docs/developer/test.md, docs/provider/cli-reference.md, docs/provider/two-mac-cluster.md, and ProviderLoop+Lifecycle.swift (line 155 adds acceptPendingClusterUpdateDrain to the existing mailbox poll loop). The docs are consistent with the claimed design: staged downloads, drain only after both Macs staged, a 120 s bound that never cancels accepted requests, a start check before exec with rollback and quarantine, and promotion after 10 minutes. The docs also say update verification stays in SelfUpdater (bundle, binary and metallib hashes, cli-reference.md). Neither the docs nor the one-line code change show a concrete regression. No keys, plaintext, prefix-cache (T-041) or coordinator-visible data paths change.

New attack surface not covered by the threat model: a pair-coordinated auto-update across the cluster link, a supervisor restart (execv), a request file for darkbloom update, a partner progress exchange, and a drain mailbox kind. The implementing sources are not in the supplied evidence: ClusterPairUpdate and ClusterPairUpdateCycle, ClusterSupervisionFiles, ProviderLoop+ClusterUpdateDrain, the LifecycleMailbox cluster claim path, and ClusterServiceUpdateRequest. The questions are not resolved and I treat them as coverage limits, not evidence of safety.
- Authentication and integrity of the partner's progress and update-request files.
- Whether a same-UID process can stall or steer updates and admission (T-059/T-060 class, availability only).
- Downgrade and release-registry binding (A-011, A-017, T-054).
- The start check runs the newly installed replaceable binary (T-043); `--version` is a liveness check, not integrity.
- Re-establishment of serving authorization after the coordinated restart (A-016, T-053, T-057).
- Drain-owner arbitration against .addonHold (TB-012, A-018).

TB-003, TB-011, TB-012 and T-043 likely need a note on the cluster auto-update path. Deeper review is requested of the omitted implementation files.
